items.title: What does a reset + force-push actually cost once a commit is shared?
items.description: Per L2's decision rule: reset is free while a commit is purely local, but the moment teammates have already pulled it, a reset + force-push forces every one of them to manually reconcile their local history (roughly a fixed number of minutes each, to notice the divergence, re-fetch, and re-apply their own work). Revert's cost stays flat at 0 regardless of how many people already pulled, because it never rewrites anything they have. Drag the number of teammates who already pulled the commit, and how messy each person's reconciliation tends to be.
items.compute: const cleanupMinutes = params.teammatesPulled * params.minutesPerConflict; return { cleanupMinutes };
